_provenance: Every case below is a minimal synthetic reproduction of a structural token observed in a real Pixiv Encyclopedia BLEACH history/source revision (see docs/pixiv_markup_normalization.md). No article prose from that page is reproduced here -- only the bracket/pipe/marker shapes themselves, rebuilt around placeholder or already-public wiki-linkable terms (character/author names, a generic pixivimage id).

cases.name: heading_marker_single_star_supported
cases.note: SUPPORTED: observed Pixiv level-1 marker is promoted to an ATX H1 for the shared markdown.py section parser.

cases.name: heading_marker_double_star_supported
cases.note: SUPPORTED: observed Pixiv level-2 marker is promoted to an ATX H2 for the shared markdown.py section parser.

cases.name: heading_marker_ascii_slash_supported
cases.note: SUPPORTED compatibility variant: ASCII slash is accepted without changing the title text.

cases.name: duplicate_heading_markers_promoted_without_dedup
cases.note: SUPPORTED promotion applies independently; duplicate headings are not deduplicated or renumbered.

cases.name: piped_wikilink_with_parenthesized_anchor
cases.note: SUPPORTED via make_link(). The anchor's parentheses are percent-encoded because vendor markdown.py's own _INLINE_LINK_RE matches a URL with [^)\s]+ -- a literal ')' would truncate the link on re-parse.

cases.name: plain_wikilink_no_anchor
cases.note: SUPPORTED. No '>' separator means the label doubles as the link target.

cases.name: duplicate_wikilinks_both_converted
cases.expected: [黒崎一護](黒崎一護)、[黒崎一護](黒崎一護)
cases.note: Both occurrences convert independently; normalization does not deduplicate repeated links.

cases.name: pixivimage_token_no_size
cases.note: SUPPORTED via make_image(). No real CDN URL is known at this layer, so the URL stays a pixivimage:ID pseudo-URL; wiring an actual asset URL is later MCP-integration work.

cases.name: pixivimage_token_with_size_suffix
cases.note: SUPPORTED. The observed :ms size suffix is preserved as the image title rather than dropped.

cases.name: pixivimage_malformed_missing_id
cases.note: UNSUPPORTED/malformed: no digits after the colon, so the token does not match and is preserved verbatim rather than guessed.

cases.name: pixivimage_malformed_non_numeric_id
cases.note: UNSUPPORTED/malformed: a non-numeric id is preserved verbatim.

cases.name: table_header_cell_marker_unsupported
cases.note: The row/'^' structure is UNSUPPORTED as a rendered table (vendor markdown.py's _is_table_start requires a '| --- |' delimiter row, which this single-line Pixiv form never has, so it safely degrades to a paragraph; no delimiter is synthesized here). The nested [[...]] wiki link inside the cell is still normalized like anywhere else in the text.

cases.name: unspaced_list_link_line
cases.note: SUPPORTED: a space is inserted after the unspaced '-' so vendor markdown.py's own _LIST_ITEM_RE (which requires \s+ after the marker) recognizes it as a list item, then the link converts as usual.

cases.name: spaced_list_link_line_already_valid
cases.note: An already-spaced list line is untouched by the list-dash fix (no-op) and only the link converts.

cases.name: next_navigation_link
cases.expected: NEXT ▶︎ [獄頤鳴鳴篇](獄頤鳴鳴篇)
cases.note: SUPPORTED: spacing is inserted around ▶︎ so the same link conversion applies; the 'NEXT ▶︎' label text itself is preserved verbatim, not translated or dropped.

cases.name: next_without_arrow_unsupported
cases.expected: NEXT[獄頤鳴鳴篇](獄頤鳴鳴篇)
cases.note: Malformed NEXT form missing the ▶︎ marker: the NEXT-spacing fix does not apply (no match), but the nested [[...]] link still converts independently, same as any other wiki link in the text.

cases.name: native_emphasis_untouched
cases.note: Standard matched-pair Markdown emphasis is left byte-for-byte untouched; vendor markdown.py's own inline renderer already understands it natively, so this layer performs no action here.

cases.name: unterminated_wikilink_malformed
cases.note: No closing ]] on the line: preserved verbatim rather than guessed.

cases.name: empty_wikilink_malformed
cases.note: Empty label: preserved verbatim rather than guessed.

cases.name: unicode_and_blank_line_run
cases.input:
テスト見出し


[[久保帯人]]
cases.expected:
テスト見出し


[久保帯人](久保帯人)
cases.note: Multi-blank-line runs are left untouched (no collapsing); only the recognized wiki-link token on its own line converts.

cases.name: crlf_line_endings_normalized
cases.expected:
見出し
[久保帯人](久保帯人)
cases.note: SUPPORTED: CRLF/CR line endings are normalized to LF via literal replacement, not a splitlines()/join() round-trip -- so line count and trailing-newline presence are preserved exactly as in the input, just with \r removed.

cases.name: lone_cr_line_endings_normalized
cases.expected:
見出し
[久保帯人](久保帯人)
cases.note: SUPPORTED: a lone \r (old Mac-style line ending) is also normalized to LF, matching pixiv_source_extract._labeled_field's existing CR tolerance.
